$comment: How many routes currently have a screen guide.
A RATCHET, and it points both ways — the same discipline src/tokens/baseline.js
applies to contrast defects. Coverage may not fall: deleting a guide, or adding a
route without one, fails the check. And when you DO write a guide, the check fails
until you raise this number, so the count cannot quietly stay stale.
24, not 22, since 2026-09-08. The two extra are not new screens: /telemetry/solar
and /admin/audit were always reachable from the rail, but they are registered from
NAV rather than written as <Route> literals, and the inventory only read literals.
So the gate reported 22 of 22 while two routes had no guide and the in-app Help
panel told a reader 'there is no guide for this screen yet'. The parser now derives
them the same way App.jsx does, and throws if it cannot.
